632	```bash
633	uv sync                                   # install (incl. dev group)
634	uv run pytest -n auto                     # tests (parallel)
635	uv run colleague backends list          # discovered backends (wheels = deprecated alias)
636	uv run colleague work "<task>" --repo . --engine mock --no-pr
637	# Backend resolution: --engine > COLLEAGUE_ENGINE > vllm-openai (never silent mock, #53).
639	# Extensibility layer (templates / hooks / approvals / session):
640	uv run colleague work --command <name> [args…] --repo . --engine mock --no-pr
641	uv run colleague commands list --repo .          # discovered templates (also: hooks list)
643	# approve verbs accept --algo sha256|md5 (default sha256) and --json.
644	uv run colleague session --repo . --engine mock  # interactive palette (--pr to push+PR)
645	
652	
653	# Lint + gates CI enforces:
654	uv run black --check colleague tests && uv run isort --check-only colleague tests
655	uv run flake8 colleague tests && uv run bandit -c pyproject.toml -r colleague
656	uv run teken cli doctor . --strict        # agent-first rubric gate
657	```
658	
659	The live vLLM proof is opt-in (`COLLEAGUE_VLLM_E2E=1 uv run pytest
660	tests/test_vllm_live.py`) and needs a rig exposing tool calling
